text:
Marta K.: hey team — emergency. i'm the primary for tonight but have to head out unexpectedly for a family thing. i can cover another 30–45m and then i'll be offline. can someone please take primary after that? i tried to swap in the rota but the handoff script is timing out. :frowning:
Ravi P.: I can take primary after 45m. where's current secondary? and what state is the bridge in?
Marta K.: thanks ravi. secondary is Jules. bridge is green but we have 2 flaky predictors in eu-west that are spiking 95p latency for short bursts (haven't paged yet). logs in the runbook link — i left notes under "current alerts". i'll paste quick pointers below.
inc-bot: Incident watch started by Marta K. — watch_id: W-1987654321. Monitored services: inference-runtime, routing. Alerts will page primary/secondary.
Marta K.: RUNBOOK: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall/runtime-bridge
Marta K.: quick commands i used earlier:
```
# show recent error rates
rquery --service inference-runtime --since 30m --group error_type
# tail predictor logs
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/predictor-eu-west -f --tail=200
```
Jules: I can stay secondary and cover the bridge for the first hour, but i'll be offline 0200-0500 UTC (meeting). if ravi can do primary after 45m that would work. what's the warm handoff plan?
Ava: i can be backup (third) in case both need relief. i'm in PST so i can take after 05:00 UTC window. FYI i have the quick mitigation playbook pinned in my messages.
Ravi P.: copy. Marta — can you paste any recent mitigation you ran? cache flushes, model rollbacks, routing changes?
Marta K.: did a soft rollback to model v2.3.1 at 18:12 local, invalidated prefix cache for a bad client (client: search-qa). then i raised routing weight on fallback pool (eu-west-b) to 10% to soak. no full restarts. I also bumped the batching window to 12ms in this region (was 8ms).
Marta K.: logs snippet:
```
[18:14:23] predictor-eu-west WARN kvcache: miss-rate 0.27 -> 0.72
[18:15:02] routing INFO fallback: bumped eu-west-b -> 10%
```
Jules: ok that explains spikes. if ravi takes primary we'll do a 3-way hlt: quick sync for 5–10m, then handover in thread and update rota.
Ravi P.: available for HLT. propose: 18:55 UTC quick call (5m) then i take over at 19:00 UTC. who will update the rota and notify incidents channel so paging sends to me?
Ava: i can update rota if you DM me the new primary window. also recommend adding this to the holiday coverage sheet so ops knows there's a gap later tonight.
Marta K.: thx all. +1 to the 18:55 call. i'll post the bridge URL and a checklist before i drop.
Marta K.: BRIDGE: https://zoom.redwood/bridges/runtime-watch-1987
Marta K.: HANDOFF CHECKLIST (quick):
- confirm incidents routing points to new primary (inc-bot config)
- ensure canary pool has 4 warm instances eu-west-b
- confirm flushing client prefix cache completed
- check token rate limiter not rejecting (rate_limit/alerts)

Ava: re inc-bot routing — follow these commands to reassign pages to ravi:
```
inc-bot assign --watch W-1987654321 --primary "Ravi P." --secondary "Jules"
inc-bot status --watch W-1987654321
```
inc-bot: assignment updated. primary -> Ravi P.; secondary -> Jules.
Jules: saw the assign, got it. will stay on bridge until ravi confirms primary take.
Ravi P.: confirmed. i'll join bridge at 18:55 and then flip to primary. can someone keep an eye on billing/quotas? last weekend we hit burst throttle and that made retries pile up.
Ava: i'll monitor quotas for next 6 hours. i'll post if any throttle > 0.5%.
Marta K.: thanks team — if you need the detailed changelog i can paste it in dm. i'm stepping off in ~35m. please escalate to oncall manager if we have >5% error rate sustained for 10m.
Jules: ack. good luck and take care Marta. :heart:
Ravi P.: thanks. will update last_message_ts when handoff complete. ping me in thread if anything changes.
inc-bot: note: next reminder scheduled in 30m to check handoff status.
Ava: quick note — since it's weekend + holiday region, i suggest enabling extended cold-start mitigation: set prewarm=2 for predictor-eu-west for next 4h. command below:
```
platformctl prewarm --service predictor-eu-west --count 2 --duration 4h
```
Ravi P.: doing prewarm now.
Ravi P.: done — prewarm set. monitoring latency and errors.
Jules: handoff complete. ravi is primary as of 19:00 UTC. rota updated and incident routing verified.
Ravi P.: i'm primary. thanks team. leaving this thread open for post-handoff updates.
Ava: copy. i'll keep quota watch and log a short post-mortem note if we see anything unusual overnight.
inc-bot: watch W-1987654321 marked active — primary: Ravi P.; secondary: Jules; watchers: Ava, Marta K.
